title: Story-1.2 command bus (DrawPipe/SnapToNode) has zero automated coverage; E4 inclusive snap boundary untested
detail: The PR's headline input path (snap → intent → DrawPipe) has no automated test; happy and error (MissingNode) paths are manual-only. The test module already depends on PacketPlumber and tests the driver, so the bus is testable in-module.
recommended_fix: Add PacketPlumber.Bus automation tests: SnapToNode boundary (grid dist2=1 snaps, 2 doesn't at kSnapRadius=36/kTilePx=26), dead-node skip, nearest/tie-break; DrawPipe missing-snap error and successful apply.

title: ScreenToGrid (bus) and GridToScreenV (view) are duplicated camera-fit inversions with no round-trip parity test
detail: Two hand-written mappings must stay exact inverses; drift silently mis-aims every click/drag while rendering stays correct. No test pins the round-trip on either surface.
recommended_fix: Add a round-trip automation test: for a viewport size, GridToScreen(ScreenToGrid(p)) == p for tile centers, and boundary pixels at tile edges map to the expected tile.

title: APPRunGameMode::StartRun re-hardcodes the golden fixture instead of using PP_Scenario; PIE-vs-golden parity asserted nowhere
evidence:
PPRunGameMode.cpp:31-33:
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 2, 2);  // SCENARIO_SOURCE
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Junction, 6, 2);  // SCENARIO_ROUTER
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 10, 2); // SCENARIO_SINK
PP_Scenario.h:48-50 (the single-source builder the comments claim to mirror):
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Terminal, 2, 2);  // SCENARIO_SOURCE
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Junction, 6, 2);  // SCENARIO_ROUTER
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Terminal, 10, 2); // SCENARIO_SINK
StartRun's demand loop is also literal: for (uint64_t T = 10; T <= 100000; T += 10) — vs the scenario's 5..95 + 98.
detail: The comment says "(PP_Scenario.h constants)" but the positions/demand are literals duplicating the golden builder. No test asserts PIE fixture parity, so silent drift makes PIE diverge from the pinned scenario.
recommended_fix: Extract the fixture spawn into a shared PP_Scenario helper (positions as exported constants) used by both StartRun and BuildProbeScenario, and add a parity CHECK in an automation test.

title: BuildSnapshot's U-E9 sim→view packet mapping (E29 semantics, Progress derivation) is unasserted
detail: The snapshot contract the whole view renders from is only checked by manual screenshots; a mapping regression (wrong FromNode/ToNode/Progress) shows as wrong packet visuals, sim unaffected.
recommended_fix: Extend an automation test: run BuildProbeScenario to a known tick, build the snapshot, assert FromNode/ToNode/Progress/bOnEdge per packet against the golden flow.

title: Enhanced Input wiring (OnDrawStart/OnDrawEnd → GameMode) has manual-only evidence despite a headless-drivable BlueprintCallable surface
detail: The full input chain's only evidence is committed PIE screenshots. BeginDraw/EndDraw were deliberately made BlueprintCallable for MCP driving, yet no automated test drives them.
recommended_fix: Add a GameMode-level automation test spawning APPRunGameMode's world and driving BeginDraw/EndDraw with computed screen positions for source→router, asserting a pipe lands.

title: UAD-8 packet-dot pool exhaustion branch (>16 packets drops the visual) is untested logic
detail: Pool capping is logic (widget lifecycle, map growth), not a visual judgment call — but it has zero coverage and U-E5's no-pixel-golden rule doesn't exempt it.
recommended_fix: Add a widget-level test feeding a synthetic snapshot pair with >16 packets; assert dot count stays 16 and stale-id dots are released.

title: New U-E2 dirty-check and SKIPABLE gate logic lack negative self-tests; dirty-check can pass vacuously
evidence:
scripts/local-ci.sh:149-153:
  dirty_before="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
  run_gates "${#GATES[@]}"
  gate_rc=$?
  dirty_after="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ "$dirty_before" != "$dirty_after" ]; then
Compare-golden.sh gained a --self-test for its negative branch in this same diff; the new U-E2/SKIPABLE branches got none.
detail: 2>/dev/null on both git calls means a git failure yields equal empty strings — vacuous pass, against the AGENTS.md fail-loud gate rule. SKIPABLE handling's FAIL path is only incidentally exercised (timings 07:11:31).
recommended_fix: Fail loud when git status itself errors (check exit code, not just output), and add a --self-test leg that dirties Config/ in a temp clone and asserts the check fires.

Grep across Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/ and tests/ for BeginDraw|EndDraw|StartRun|BuildSnapshot|PPRunGameMode|PPRunView|SnapToNode|ScreenToGrid|CommandBus returns no matches.
